comparison.objective: Load and center a wafer on a spin coater using tweezers and an aligner; candidate screens mixed solids.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile wafer edge handling, tool transfer, and submillimeter centering versus bimanual screen agitation and particle flow.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer flat and centered without touch/drop, lid shut versus ≥98% media recovery with no washer escape or spill.
comparison.reason: Precision wafer placement does not test granular separation.
